items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: Friesen. Like David Friesen. No relation, but Kevin Friesen.

ctx.x: Friesen. Like David Friesen. No relation, but Kevin Friesen. And we were kind of in his camp. And he was serious, meaning a 10 p.m. to 8 a.m. rehearsal was not uncommon for us. So ninety percent of people that came through the door in his scene left immediately because he was too rough around the edges and it was too much of a commitment just work-wise and emotionally for a lot of people. But so I stayed. I was drawn to him and he was of course, he opened my mind up to everything: avante garde, he had thousands…
